independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG3 scope. In this round I wrote only QA tests and evidence: the spec docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-4/e2e/dg3-qa-r4.spec.ts (outside the frozen candidate), the evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-4/, this record and its narrative. Every result comes from my own runs in two disposable clones of 171a0b57 under $TMPDIR, both removed at the end: review-dg3 for all suites, and probe-dg3 for the throwaway mutation probes only. HEAD was fd27c10 at the start and 28044a4 at the end. Every intermediate commit came from other reviewers' auto-committed evidence and touched only docs/delivery/. The candidate ID recomputes identical in the working tree at the start and end, in the clone, at --ref 171a0b5 and at --ref HEAD (757 files). I did not open any other reviewer's round-4 record or evidence, and I formed my verdict from my own runs. Product gates G1-G6 are business approvals inside the product and never imply DG0-DG7. Every business decision in my tests is a synthetic demo record that approves nothing real.

checks_run.actual: M1: nocodegen EXIT 1, 73 failed / 126 passed / 1 skipped. M2: EXIT 1, 24 failed / 175 passed / 1 skipped. M3: EXIT 1, 3 failed / 196 passed / 1 skipped. Every failure is 'EvalError: Code generation from strings disallowed', and there are 0 'could not be processed' lines, so the round-3 conversion of EvalError no longer happens. The normal unit-node process passes all three mutations (219/219), as ADR-0024 §6 states for run-time keys. Each file was restored: git status clean, nocodegen EXIT 0 (199 passed, 1 skipped). The skip is fuzz.test.ts's it.skipIf(NOCODEGEN) ESLint-config assertion, skipped because ESLint's ajv needs new Function; it runs and passes in unit-node.
